technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Implement the pluggable runtime SPI for module deployment using standard Java Service Provider Interface mechanisms.
Leverage Spring Boot's auto-configuration and embedded server capabilities for the isolated Boot-based ModuleRunner.
Use a standard CI/CD pipeline tool (e.g., GitHub Actions or Jenkins) to add the 'install' target build step.

assumptions: The 'DEBS challenge' refers to an existing ongoing task requiring final code integration and documentation for submission.

The 'jdbchdfs' and 'TupleBuilder' are existing components in the codebase that require profiling and optimization.
The developer has access to SQLServer and GPDB test environments to execute and compare Sqoop jobs.
The 'repository' abstraction for stream/job definitions is currently tightly coupled and needs to be decoupled into an SPI.
The developer is familiar with the Spring XD codebase and the required technologies (Kafka, Sqoop, GPDB).

activities.activity_description: Complete the remaining work with the DEBS challenge, including final code integration, testing, and documentation for submission.
Add a new CI build configuration to include the 'install' target to verify target expectations automatically.
Publish the XD + Kafka Proof of Concept in the samples repository to serve as reference architecture.
Revisit performance benchmarks with new improvements to verify optimizations around the jdbchdfs component.
Bench test cases around TupleBuilder to identify bottlenecks and tune for performance optimizations.

activities.activity_name: GPDB Parameter UX Simplification & Sqoop Testing
activities.activity_description: Simplify the UX around parameters for GPDB to avoid manual escaping, and test the Sqoop job with SQLServer and GPDB to identify UX differences.

activities.activity_name: Module Deployment Migration to Runtime SPI
activities.activity_description: Migrate module deployment from the 'repository' abstraction to a pluggable runtime SPI architecture.
Build an isolated Boot-based ModuleRunner for use in container-managed environments to run XD without the hard requirement for running xd-containers.
